# env

Host / container environment helpers (conda, TheRock, amdgpu build, PyTorch).

| Script | Role |
|--------|------|
| `setup_all.sh` | Top-level setup entry |
| `setup_conda.sh` | Conda env |
| `install_the_rock.sh` | TheRock install |
| `build_pytorch.sh` | PyTorch build |
| `update_amdgpu_build.sh` | amdgpu package update |
| `check_host_setting.sh` | Host sanity checks |
| `.bashrc` | Shell snippet for this box |
